thread:
Aisha (CSM): Hi team — HelioCare asked for a short, focused enablement track next week: two 60-min sessions (Dedicated migration walk-through + Cost & perf tuning). They want EMEA-friendly times and a recorded session. Can we slot this and assign owners?
Jonah (CS Lead): EMEA-friendly means starting ~09:30-11:00 UTC works best for their ops folks. I can lead the migration session but need a SE to cover the live demo.
Priya (Enablement): I can own scheduling + slide deck master. Devon can you do the demo? I have a template for prework and a 3-question feedback survey we can run after.
Devon (Solutions Eng): Yep I can do the demo — will need a test tenant and a short runbook for the customer to follow. Can we get access by Monday morning?
Aisha (CSM): Marta from HelioCare is in thread — Marta, can you confirm attendee list and preferred day next week? Also any blockers for test tenant access? @Marta
Marta (Customer): Thanks — prefer Tue or Thu, EMEA morning is perfect. We'll have 6 core attendees. Test tenant access: we can get it but need the instructions sent to our infra team (I'll paste contacts).
Priya (Enablement): Proposed slots: Tue 09:30 UTC (migration) + Thu 10:00 UTC (cost/perf). Recording + transcript OK?
Marta (Customer): Yes, recording and transcript please. Can we get slides beforehand?
Aisha (CSM): We'll share slides 24h before. Jonah + Devon will own migration deck, Priya will own cost deck. Devon, can you list any infra pre-reqs here so Marta can pass to infra?
Devon (Solutions Eng): Pre-reqs: SSH access to staging (or screen-share demo), sample dataset (anonymized), and a staging API key. I'll paste minimal commands:
Devon (Solutions Eng): ```
# verify kv cache warmup
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/verify -d '{"check":"kv"}'
```
Jonah (CS Lead): Also recommend a 10-min onboarding pre-read + 15-min live Q&A. That reduces confusion and keeps the session tight.
Priya (Enablement): I'll publish the pre-read and the 3-question survey (ease, clarity, next-steps) and set up a short automated reminder 30m before each session.
EnablementBot: New recording policy: recordings will be stored for 30 days by default. If HelioCare needs longer retention, escalate to legal.
Aisha (CSM): Heads-up — renewal health flag is yellow for HelioCare (usage dip last month). Suggested we add a 10-min exec check-in in the week following the sessions to surface any risks. Anyone free for a short executive sync?
Jonah (CS Lead): I can join the exec check-in; Aisha, can you lead?
Aisha (CSM): Will do. Marta, would HelioCare prefer an exec check-in the Friday after sessions (15-20 min)?
Marta (Customer): Friday works. We'll invite our Head of ML to that one.
Priya (Enablement): Action list: 1) Devon to paste final demo commands & confirm staging access (by Mon 16:00 UTC). 2) Jonah + Devon to finish migration slides (by Mon 18:00 UTC). 3) Priya to prepare pre-read + survey + calendar invites (by Mon 20:00 UTC). 4) Aisha to schedule exec check-in and share invite (Thu EOD).
Devon (Solutions Eng): Acknowledged — I'll try to get staging creds by Mon 12:00 UTC and will post here when done. :white_check_mark:
Jonah (CS Lead): I'll review the slides and add a short rollback checklist.
Marta (Customer): Thanks everyone — we'll confirm attendee names by EOD today and ping infra for access. Looking forward. :handshake:
Aisha (CSM): Great — I'll create the calendar blocks once Priya has the invites + pre-read. Adding a reminder to include the renewal health note in the exec sync agenda.
Priya (Enablement): Noted. I'll also attach the recording consent language for Marta to share with attendees.
Devon (Solutions Eng): Final note — during the migration demo I'll show an example of cache warmup + a perf baseline. That should give HelioCare tangible next steps.
Aisha (CSM): Thanks all. Closing loop — will update thread when invites are out. :sparkles:
